scope: Task-independent native agent messages/status updates, not task creation, work dispatch or automatic execution-completion handback

installedArtifactPreflight.limitation: Dirty-source preflight before final commit, not the final release report

safetyAndRecovery: Exact sender binding and participant-scoped inbox/sent reads
Bounded content and 100 outstanding messages per recipient
Immutable operation keys and backend retry reconciliation
Persisted native intent before send and no blind resend after lost reply
Missing original local intent blocks snapshot reconstruction
Receiving-chat replacement blocks unsafe admission or retargeting
Delivered native outcome is not approval or proof of action
Automatic message acknowledgement/reply loops are blocked
